study type: Retrospective analysis of prospectively collected data
exposure: Type of ART (IVF/ICSI, FET, ODR, insemination)
finding: Although GDM prevalence was higher in the ART group, ART was not associated with an increased GDM risk after adjusting for age, parity, and BMI, and pregnancy outcomes were similar between groups except for cesarean section rates.
mod_finding: While ART itself was not associated with GDM risk after adjusting for confounders, women who conceived through ART and developed GDM had higher C-section rates compared to those who conceived spontaneously and developed GDM.
